method: Separate sequential source processes using identical synthetic data and queued Qt paint; no profiler. First context opening has no cached source index. Raw Data shows the full recording, so its timing is not a same-window comparison.

before.conditions: Linux/offscreen, 1450x920; source UI, synthetic 100 Hz gyroscope recording, Amsterdam clock, no profiler; includes queued Qt painting

after.conditions: Source UI, Fusion, 1450x920; synthetic 100 Hz gyroscope recording, Amsterdam clock, no profiler; includes queued Qt painting. Context displays 20 seconds; Data displays the full recording.
